videos.title: Do This Every Day and Watch Your Life Change | Tony Robbins
videos.description:
You're not stuck because you lack information. You're stuck because you haven't made a decision.

In this clip, Tony Robbins and Jay Shetty talk about the story of a private who asked a general how he could possibly make one of the biggest decisions of his career without knowing everything, and the answer he got.

Tony explains why the smartest people are often the worst investors, the difference between deciding, committing and resolving, and the six-step process he uses to make big decisions, the same one behind a single choice that made him $400 million.

Learn about why the real problem isn't the decision you made, but the one you keep putting off, and the question Tony asks about God that his own son couldn't answer.

JAY'S DAILY WISDOM DELIVERED STRAIGHT TO YOUR INBOX
Join 900,000+ readers discovering how small daily shifts create big life change with my free newsletter. Subscribe https://news.jayshetty.me/subscribe

Chapters
0:00 — Why you feel stuck
3:10 — Why the smartest people make terrible investors
5:02 — The general, the private, and Rule 14
7:48 — Why it's only a decision if you act
9:36 — Deciding vs. committing vs. resolving
13:17 — The power of problems
15:51 — The six-step decision process
20:16 — Systems and spirit
25:03 — The art of fulfilment
28:19 — Success without fulfilment
31:10 — The $87 million orange square
35:03 — Where self-esteem really comes from
37:25 — Scoring your life 0 to 10
39:38 — Being a dad at 25 vs. 61
43:55 — The four seasons of life
48:35 — The gambler who wasn't in heaven
50:03 — What a relationship with God feels like
